components.name: Alert
components.purpose: A success, warning, or danger message whose announcement behavior and Theme-independent meaning travel together.

components.name: AlertDialog
components.purpose: A destructive decision that stays modal until an explicit safe or confirming action restores invoking focus.

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: A rectangular status marker, sized to sit inside running text.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: The Kit's only control: three emphases so a view can have exactly one affirmative action.

components.name: Card
components.purpose: A bounded surface whose header, body and footer stay in step through one variant.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: A visibly named native binary choice whose Field associations, validity, focus, and submitted value stay together.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.purpose: Preformatted source whose exact whitespace and canonical Button copy affordance travel together.

components.name: DescriptionList
components.purpose: Native term and detail pairs whose content stays caller-owned while Density controls their spacing.

components.name: Dialog
components.purpose: A labeled modal that contains keyboard focus, dismisses with Escape, and returns focus to its trigger.

components.name: Disclosure
components.purpose: One canonical Button revealing one associated region while the surrounding arrangement and detail stay local.

components.name: Divider
components.purpose: A horizontal or vertical rule whose separator semantics travel with its visual direction.

components.name: EmptyState
components.purpose: What stands where a list has nothing in it: a sentence saying so, and the caller's own way out.

components.name: Field
components.purpose: One accessible form relationship: label, help, error and required semantics passed intact to its control.

components.name: Heading
components.purpose: A heading whose outline level and Theme type role are separate choices, so a section sits at the right depth and the right size.

components.name: Icon
components.purpose: A lucide glyph whose size follows local Density and whose stroke color names a semantic Theme role.

components.name: Image
components.purpose: A picture that requires its alternative, reserves its box from intrinsic dimensions or a ratio, and loads lazily unless marked as the priority (LCP) image; srcset and picture sources come from the app's own asset pipeline.

components.name: Indicator
components.purpose: Caller-owned marker content placed at a logical edge without changing the anchored content's focus behavior.

components.name: Input
components.purpose: Native text entry with the platform's attributes, validity and focus behavior left intact.

components.name: Kbd
components.purpose: A key cap — or a chord, rendered as one cap per key with the separator between them.

components.name: Label
components.purpose: Native control naming whose association, click-to-focus behavior, and caller-owned text remain intact.

components.name: Link
components.purpose: A native destination whose persistent underline and focus ring remain perceivable without colour.

components.name: LoadingIndicator
components.purpose: A motion-aware spinner whose polite busy status and sentence travel together for every audience.

components.name: Logo
components.purpose: The DS's placement of a Brand-owned Mark: layout, surface, clearspace, and a refusal where the pinned release ships nothing.

components.name: NavigationScope
components.purpose: An injectable navigation seam: every in-app link inside it activates through the consumer's router instead of the browser, and nothing changes without one.

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: A collision-aware non-modal dialog whose canonical Button trigger, dismissal, and focus return travel together.

components.name: Progress
components.purpose: Determinate or indeterminate linear work whose visual fill and accessible value share one normalized range.

components.name: SectionHeading
components.purpose: A heading whose visual weight and outline depth are set separately, so neither has to be sacrificed to the other.

components.name: Select
components.purpose: Native choice selection whose options, form value, keyboard interaction and focus stay under the platform contract.

components.name: Skeleton
components.purpose: Density-aware loading silhouettes for tables, KPIs, charts and content, with optional loading ownership and motion control.

components.name: Stack
components.purpose: Vertical flow whose small, medium, and large gaps remain live Density roles in nested scopes.

components.name: StateIllustration
components.purpose: Token-coloured SVG state artwork, individually imported for errors, zero states and confirmations, without fonts or external resources.

components.name: StatusIndicator
components.purpose: A status mark whose required text remains available when the label is visually hidden, so colour is never the message.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: One selected panel at a time, with associated labels and roving arrow-key focus over caller-owned content.

components.name: Textarea
components.purpose: Native multiline entry with rows, wrapping, constraints, validity and resize behavior left intact.

components.name: Timeline
components.purpose: Caller-owned events in native chronological order, with machine-readable times and canonical links where events have destinations.

components.name: ToggleButton
components.purpose: A canonical Button whose pressed state is explicit to sighted and assistive-technology users.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Supplemental pointer and keyboard help for a trigger whose accessible name remains useful without it.

components.name: ActivityFeed
components.purpose: Caller-owned application events presented through the canonical ordered Timeline and its machine-readable times.

components.name: ApplicationWorkspace
components.purpose: A named workspace composing caller-owned resource navigation, document tabs, commands and content with independent host state.

components.name: ChangeReview
components.purpose: Explicit proposed values and observed per-item outcomes with request-only apply and discard actions.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.purpose: Global caller-owned commands searched through the canonical Combobox inside the canonical Popover focus lifecycle.

components.name: ErrorBoundary
components.purpose: Native client render recovery with safe fallback content and explicit retry or identity reset.

components.name: ListRow
components.purpose: One row of a list, rendering the element its behavior calls for — a link, a button, or neither.

components.name: NavItem
components.purpose: One entry in a navigation, which says where you are rather than only tinting itself.

components.name: OutcomeScreen
components.purpose: Present a successful or failed operation with an illustration, guidance and caller-owned actions.

components.name: PageHeading
components.purpose: The one h1 at the root of an application page, pairing caller-owned context and actions without owning the page assembly.

components.name: Pill
components.purpose: A round-ended token for a filter or a tag, optionally dismissible.

components.name: SettingsRow
components.purpose: A setting label and separate description with a natively associated field and independently named actions.

components.name: ShortcutHelp
components.purpose: Contextual keyboard reference inside the canonical Dialog without registering application commands.

components.name: SidebarRail
components.purpose: A compact application and workspace switcher whose labelled icon controls keep selection external and keyboard focus roving.

components.name: SplitView
components.purpose: Two panes and a divider you can move with a pointer or with the arrow keys, over arithmetic that needs no DOM.

components.name: Toolbar
components.purpose: A named row or column of canonical controls with one roving tab stop and native destinations left intact.

components.name: WorkspaceTabs
components.purpose: Closable document tabs with independent draft and execution states, retained native panels and caller-owned close decisions.

components.name: DeveloperPanel
components.purpose: Dock and resize caller-owned developer content with optional context tabs.

components.name: DeveloperRequestInspector
components.purpose: Inspect caller-supplied request, response, headers and measured timings.

components.name: Diagram
components.purpose: Directed connections and stable automatic layout for architecture and flows.

components.name: DiffExplorer
components.purpose: Explore caller-supplied changes with search, selection, field comparison and raw records.

components.name: DocumentViewer
components.purpose: A searchable master-detail document surface with caller-controlled selection and body, field, or raw modes.

components.name: EventSeriesExplorer
components.purpose: Inspect event rates, metric values and records with bounded time buckets.

components.name: Graph
components.purpose: An accessible network with a deterministic SVG first paint and a lazily loaded interactive engine.

components.name: GraphExplorer
components.purpose: Explore networks as canvas, SVG or tables with community grouping, relationship details and host-owned queries.

components.name: KeyValueExplorer
components.purpose: Browse slash-delimited keys, filter prefixes and inspect original or nested JSON values.

components.name: KpiCard
components.purpose: A DS-owned metric summary with textual delta direction and an optional caller-supplied sparkline.

components.name: PanZoomViewport
components.purpose: A caller-owned drawing with fit, anchored zoom, keyboard navigation and pointer pan or pinch, without a rendering engine.

components.name: QueueExplorer
components.purpose: Inspect queue messages, delivery metadata and event envelopes with caller-owned insertion.

components.name: Sparkline
components.purpose: A compact, accessible LayerChart trend that remains small enough to compose into dense summaries.

components.name: StatsExplorer
components.purpose: Inspect numeric statistics as KPIs, gauges or a table without changing their readings.

components.name: Table
components.purpose: A state-local rich grid with sorting, filtering, paging, column visibility, virtualization, and explicitly staged edits.

components.name: TableExplorer
components.purpose: Filter and edit result rows with stable source identity and caller-owned query projection.

components.name: TimeSeries
components.purpose: A token-painted LayerChart time series that supports line and area readings without an inline palette.

components.name: TreeView
components.purpose: A caller-owned hierarchy with roving focus, keyboard expansion, selection, rename, and reorder proposals.

components.name: VectorExplorer
components.purpose: Browse vector metadata, coordinates and scores, and run caller-owned cancellable searches.
